overview:
Dr. Loretta T. Lee is a PhD-prepared, nationally board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner and nationally Certified Nurse Educator focused on health promotion for those from underserved populations and federal health policies that will eliminate or reduce health inequity.  She is passionate about addressing the high prevalence of obesity and diabetes, which significantly contributes to chronic diseases among people of color.

With a national perspective and realizing the need to bridge the gaps between healthcare and health policies that affect underserved populations, Dr. Lee has leveraged her practice experience and academic expertise to inform the implementation of state and national programs to increase access to care and advocate for federal health care policies that will eliminate or reduce inequities in health outcomes for historically underserved populations. She has presented her research and other scholarly works at local, regional, national, and international conferences.
